manifest.author: Lovenndme
manifest.description: Personal usage profile page for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: cumulative tokens, peak day, longest task, activity streaks, token mix, a 12-month token-activity heatmap and a per-provider billing breakdown, all folded from the local session logs.

compatibility.note: Host half uses ctx.sessionQuery (listSessions / readSession incl. inheritedEventCount) and ctx.webServer.register; client half uses slots.inject/register plus the locale service. On a host without those APIs the plugin fails to load instead of showing wrong numbers.

manifest.name: dsh-profile-stats
